text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hyah...! L-Let's not do that after all!
It tickles way too much!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh! This is seriously no joke!
I'm starting to feel super hot...!

One day after school. I often saw students
bumping their tails together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It seems as though the entire academy has been caught up
in the winds of celebration since this morning.
choice_data_list: Shall we ask someone what happened?

text_block_list.text: Just then, Nice Nature and the others happened to pass by, so I decided to ask if they knew anything.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, last night was the series finale of
'LOVE-dacchi', after all~.
That's why everyone's been so hyped up since this morning.

"『LOVE Dacchi』... It's a youth drama about Umamusume set in a fictional high school.
It's a popular topic of conversation among the students."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's not like I'm a die-hard fan or anything,
but that thing in the finale was really bad for my heart, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To think that right at the end, our tails would—
...No, I must not.
Just remembering it makes my heart flutter a little...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My, Ikuno, have you caught a chill?
Please take care of yourself...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, I'm sorry.
I'm feeling fine, but, um...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Um, it was just a bit thrilling, you know!
...Well, but in a way,
it kind of warms your heart~... or something?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Is it like taking a deep breath in the forest?
Like feeling your chest fill with a fresh green breeze.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Umm, it's close, I guess... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My, that actually sounds quite interesting.
Would you mind teaching me how it's done?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh, aah... Teacher Ikuno, please!
This is way too embarrassing and heavy of a load for me...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Me?!
...A-All right!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: You bring your tails together like this... and wrap them around once... twice... Um, it's that sort of movement.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see.
Tail to tail...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
!? Z-Zephyr-san, please wait!
Do you intend to do this with me...?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...? Was that not okay?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I-It's not that I can't do it, okay?!
Umm, well, it's just not something
you spring on someone so suddenly, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even in dramas, a "tail hug" is for someone really
special, like... um, a partner?
Yeah, it's something you do with a special partner!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A special partner...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah, if that's the case—
(Rustle, rustle...)

Something soft stroked
across my back... I think!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... A gentle breeze... no, tranquility?
I feel like I sensed something, but...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It seems that a refreshing green breeze will only blow if it's tail-to-tail.
It seems Yamanin Zephyr slightly misunderstood what a "tail hug" means.

Her bold behavior has left everyone around her
completely flustered...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Still... hehe, it doesn't feel bad at all.
If you'd like, once more—"
choice_data_list: Zephyr, let's head to training soon!
(Patiently explain the facts for the future.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That's right...! Trainer, let us be on our way.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
What a skillful dodge...
So this is what it means to be an adult...!

Afterward, Yamanin Zephyr tackled her training
earnestly and made steady progress!

—And so, I carefully explained to her
what a “tail hug” actually meant...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ......Well, now.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I was sure that, well...
...Well...
